answer: Progressive fee taper: new identities pay steep transaction fees, like a toll echoing louder in an empty canyon. Fees taper only as honest throughput builds a proven track record, each reduction a fresh pigment layered on the agent's history. A sybil farmer minting a yarrow field of fakes pays full price per identity forever, since none ever accumulate real history, while one honest agent quickly reaches near-zero fees. Faking volume stays cheap; faking a fee-discounted history is not.
